source: 584 “Helper”
target: 584 “Auxiliator”

source: 584 “Helper”
target: 584 “Auxiliator”

source: Inside the underwater spaceship, in the silvery hall.
target: Intra navem subaquaticam, in aula argentea.

source: Lumian, enveloped by crimson, nearly white flames, transformed into a fireball and hurtled towards Ultraman Lato Guiaro.
target: Lumian, circumdatus flammis coccineis et fere albis, in globum ignis mutatus et versus Ultraman Lato Guiaro festinanter volavit.

source: The key April Fool’s member remained composed.
target: Membrum clavis Aprilis Stulti tranquillum mansit.

source: Holding his breath, he thrust forward with his left palm.
target: Spiritum continens, manu sinistra immisit.

source: Lumian instantly sensed an invisible force resisting him, causing the blazing crimson fireball to decelerate abruptly, akin to a trapped insect in transparent amber.
target: Lumian statim sensit vim invisibilem, quae ei opposita erat, qua globus ignis coccineus ardens subito retardaretur, sicut insectum captum in succino perspicuo.

source: Seizing the moment, Lato Guiaro raised his right hand, clenching it into a fist.
target: Momento usus, Lato Guiaro dextram manum elevavit, eam in pugnum conclusit.

source: A ball of blazing white pure sunlight condensed and compressed, swiftly morphing into a thick, formidable laser aimed at Lumian, fused with the crimson near-white fireball.
target: Globus lucis solaris candidae purae, ardens, condensatus et compressus, celeriter in densum et formidabilem laser mutatus in Lumian, qui cum globo ignis coccinei fere albi coniunctus erat, evasit.

source: This ability resulted from merging the Sun pathway and the Sea boon, utilizing the power of the Sun pathway to propel the Sea boon’s Weakening Ray.
target: Haec facultas ex coniunctione viae solis et beneficii maris orta est, per vim viae solis radium debilitantis beneficii maris impellendo.

source: Though it no longer altered the target’s body gradually, causing various negative symptoms, its penetration and melting effects were significantly enhanced, capable of directly injuring or even killing the target.
target: Quamquam non iam corpus destinatum paulatim mutabat, diversas symptomata negativa efficiebat, effectus penetrationis et liquefactionis tamen notabiliter amplificati erant, qui directe vulnerare aut etiam interficere destinatum poterant.

source: In the enclosed, poisonous gas-filled environment with the constant threat of malice, Lato Guiaro sought to conclude the battle swiftly rather than wait for Lumian Lee to weaken gradually.
target: In ambitu clauso, gas venenoso repleto, cum semper minā malitiae, Lato Guiaro bellum celeriter conficere contendit potius quam exspectare ut Lumian Lee paulatim debilitaretur.

source: Thus, he opted for Sun Ray instead of Weakening Ray.
target: Itaque radium solis pro radium debilitantis eligere statuit.

source: At laser speed, Sun Ray struck the crimson fireball, melting a substantial hole into it.
target: Celeritate laseris, radium solis globum ignis coccineum percussit, ingentem cavum in eo liquefaciendo fundens.

source: The fireball lost its structural integrity and exploded, scattering like rain.
target: Globus ignis integritatem suam amisit et explosus est, disseminatus ut pluvia.

source: Yet, Lumian was nowhere among the remnants.
target: Attamen, Lumian nusquam inter reliquias apparuit.

source: He seemed to have vanished into thin air.
target: Videbatur in aere tenuissimo evanuisse.

source: Simultaneously, behind Ultraman Lato Guiaro, Lumian’s figure, adorned with the Lie earring, swiftly materialized.
target: Simul, post Ultraman Lato Guiaro, figura Lumiani, cum ornamento auriculari Lie induta, celeriter apparuit.

source: Initially, Lumian transformed into a fireball and soared towards Lato Guiaro, intending to force him into using Beyonder powers and counterattack.
target: Initio, Lumian in globum ignis transformatus est et versus Lato Guiaro volavit, eum cogere cupiens ut potentias Beyonder adhiberet atque contra impetum pararet.

source: This allowed him to “fix” his original location, not shifting prematurely, creating an opportunity to “teleport” behind the target in the fireball state for a surprise attack.
target: Hoc ei permisit locum originarium suum stabile retinere, non praecoepi mutare, occasionem condere ut post scopus in statu globi ignis “teleportaret” ad impetum insidiosum.

source: Having faced bestowed of the sea before, Lumian was aware of Lato Guiaro’s ability to manipulate the weight or floatation of objects using the power of the land and stars, altering their speed.
target: Iam pridem beneficium maris expertus, Lumian scivit facultatem Lato Guiaro, utens potentia terrae et siderum, ut pondus vel levationem rerum regeret atque eorum celeritatem mutaret.

source: To successfully use Spirit World Traversal in his fireball form, Lumian borrowed Lie’s Flame Controlling ability.
target: Ut transitus Mundi Spiritus in forma globi ignis feliciter efficeret, Lumian mutuatus est facultatem regendi flammarum a Lie.

source: As his figure materialized, he promptly opened his mouth and hissed at Ultraman Lato Guiaro, less than two meters away.
target: Dum figura eius apparuit, celeriter os aperuit et sibilavit ad Ultraman Lato Guiaro, qui minus quam duobus metris distantem erat.

source: “Ha!”
target: “Ha!”

source: A pale-yellow beam, resembling gas, shot towards the April Fool’s key member.
target: Radius luteus pallidus, qui gas similis erat, versus membrum clavis Aprilis Stulti profectus est.

source: Lato Guiaro didn’t have time to turn around, sensing the impending danger through his fate perception, a skill obtained from deciphering the Language of the Stars Beyonder powers.
target: Lato Guiaro non habuit tempus se convertere, per sensum fatum imminentis periculum agnovens, arte ex Lingua Stellarum potentiarum Beyonder adeptus.

source: Specks of starlight emerged in his eyes.
target: Particulae fulgor stellarum in oculis eius apparuerunt.

source: He identified several “passages” in the silver hall suffused with cerulean-blue gasses, imperceptible to ordinary humans.
target: Plura “transitus” in aula argentea, gasibus caeruleo diffusis, ab hominibus ordinariis imperceptis, agnovit.

source: Hastily choosing one, he pounced over—a navigating ability bestowed by the sea.
target: Festinanter unum eligit, et super eum insilivit — ars navigationis a mari data.

source: Simultaneously, uncertain of evading the attack from behind, Lato Guiaro infused the surroundings with layers of golden light.
target: Simul, nescit an impetum e tergo evaderet, Lato Guiaro ambitum stratis lucis aureae imbuivit.

source: This was the Purification Halo of a Sequence 5 Priest of Light of the Sun pathway.
target: Hoc erat Corona Purificandi Sacerdotis Lucis in Sequentae V viae Solis.

source: Amidst the harrumph, the pale-yellow beam swept past Lato Guiaro’s back, hidden somewhere in the void.
target: Inter strepitum, radius luteus pallidus per tergum Lato Guiaro traiecit, alicubi in vacuo absconditus.

source: The key member of April Fool’s, code name Ultraman, fainted, but his momentum remained.
target: Membrum clavis Aprilis Stulti, sub nomine Ultraman, in desidiam lapsus est, sed impetum suum conservavit.

source: He continued into the illusory passageway, hidden from ordinary eyes, traversing space and dimensions.
target: Per transitum illusorium, ab oculis ordinariis celatum, spatium et dimensiones perambulavit.

source: Lumian, within two meters, couldn’t “teleport” away in time and was enveloped by the Purification Halo.
target: Lumian, intra duos metra, non potuit tempore “teleportare” et Corona Purificationis eum involvit.

source: His heart ached, as if something sought to tear his body apart and crawl out.
target: Cor eius dolebat, quasi aliquid conaretur corpus eius discerpere atque exire.

source: Faintly, he heard the illusory ravings of the entity known as Inevitability, Mr. Fool, or both.
target: Subtiliter audivit delirationes illusoriae entitatis, quae “Inevitability”, “Mr. Fool”, aut utrumque appellabatur.

source: Unclear but unsettling, they made Lumian’s brain feel pulled out of his skull by an invisible hand.
target: Quamquam ambigua sed perturbantia, faciebant ut cerebrum Lumiani, quasi per manum invisibile, extra cranium evelli videretur.

source: Despite an Ascetic’s endurance, Lumian couldn’t help but groan in pain.
target: Non obstante patientia ascetae, Lumian dolore inevitabiliter gemere coactus est.

source: Collapsing to the ground, he curled up.
target: Cadens in terram, se convolvit.

source: A similar experience occurred in his Cordu dream, a reaction after being sprinkled by Valentine’s holy water.
target: Experientia similis evenit in somnio Cordu, ut reactio postquam aquam sanctam Valentinii aspergeretur.

source: Lato Guiaro’s Purification Halo, an advanced Sun Halo, had evolved from harmless to a partial Sun Holy Water effect.
target: Corona Purificationis Lato Guiaro, corona solis provecta, ex inermitate in partem effectus aquae sanctae solis evoluta erat.

source: It could exorcize evil spirits and purify the evil power within a target’s body.
target: Poterat spiritus malos exorcizare et vim malignam in corpore destinato purgare.

source: As Lato Guiaro lay unconscious, the Purification Halo vanished in a flash, only partially dispelling the poisonous gas.
target: Dum Lato Guiaro in statu insciente iacebat, Corona Purificationis in momento evanuit, solum parcum gas venenatum dispellens.

source: Similarly, the unconscious Lato Guiaro couldn’t progress through the illusory passageway, breaking free and falling three to four meters in front of Lumian.
target: Similiter, Lato Guiaro inscius per transitum illusorium progredi non potuit, evadens et tres ad quattuor metra ante Lumian cadens.

source: The impact left him in pain, slowly regaining consciousness.
target: Impetus eum dolore affecit, paulatim conscientiam recipiens.

source: At that moment, Lumian slowly recovered from the intense pain induced by the Purification Halo.
target: Illo momento, Lumian ab intenso dolore, quem Corona Purificationis intulit, paulatim se restituit.

source: Lato Guiaro, just waking up and still uncertain of the situation, instinctively re-entered the illusory passageway to increase the distance between himself and Lumian Lee.
target: Lato Guiaro, modo evigilans et rem nondum certa habens, instinctu transitum illusorium iterum ingressus est, ut distantia inter eum et Lumian Lee augeretur.

source: This move aimed to avoid another strike from Lumian’s Psychic Piercing-like ability or any other unforeseen attacks.
target: Hoc consilium destinatum erat ut alium ictum ex facultate psychica Lumiani, simile “Psychic Piercing”, aut alias inopinatas impetūs vitaret.

source: Upon crawling back to the hall through the exit of the illusory passageway, Lumian had already raised his head and regained his composure, though his forehead was soaked in cold sweat.
target: Reveniens ad aulam per exitum transitus illusorii, Lumian iam caput attollit et compositum restituit, etsi frontem frigida sudore madens habebat.

source: Observing this, Lato Guiaro felt neither pity, disappointment, nor regret.
target: Observans hoc, Lato Guiaro nec miserationem, nec delusionem, nec paenitentiam sensit.

source: Instead, he was pleasantly surprised.
target: Immo, potius, eum laete admiratus est.

source: It’s effective!
target: Efficax est!

source: Purification Halo is effective against Lumian Lee!
target: Corona Purificationis adversus Lumian Lee efficax est!

source: After confirming that the adventurer Louis Berry was indeed Lumian Lee, Lato Guiaro contemplated how to strategize if he were to engage in a battle with him.
target: Postquam confirmavit adventorem Ludovicum Berry re vera Lumian Lee esse, Lato Guiaro meditatus est quomodo se in bello consulere posset, si cum eo pugnarentur.

source: It was simple with the authority of the Governor of the Sea.
target: Facile erat cum auctoritate Praefecti Maris.

source: He could repeatedly cast the other party into the Cosmic Void, making him lose himself over and over.
target: Poterat alterum iterum atque iterum in Vacuum Cosmicum proicere, faciens ut se iterum atque iterum amitteret.

source: Without the Governor of the Sea’s authority, he had to consider how to exploit Lumian Lee’s vulnerabilities.
target: Sine auctoritate Praefecti Maris, cogitandum erat quomodo vulnerabilitates Lumian Lee ex usuris convertirentur.

source: Lumian Lee’s unique characteristics were clear—possessing a sealing power of the same origin as the Celestial Worthy, with a high-ranking creature sealed within him.
target: Proprietates unicas Lumian Lee manifestae erant—potentiam sigillandi eadem originis habentem ac cum creatura praecipua intra eum sigillata.

source: Beyonders in this state often had false high-level statuses and enjoyed numerous conveniences, but they were susceptible to the Sun pathway’s abilities.
target: Beyonderi in hoc statu saepe gradus altissimos falsos habebant et commoditatibus plurimis fruebantur, sed erant susceptibiles potestate viae solis.

source: Lato Guiaro wasn’t certain about the effectiveness of the Sun Halo, Cleave of Purification, and other abilities, nor was he sure of the Purification Halo’s potency.
target: Lato Guiaro de efficacitate Coronae Solis, “Cleave of Purification”, aliisque facultatibus non certus erat, nec de potentia Coronae Purificationis dubitabatur.

source: The only certainty lay in the effectiveness of the Sun Holy Water he could create.
target: Unica certitudo in efficacia aquae sanctae solis, quam creare posset, iacebat.

source: Therefore, if the Purification Halo proved ineffective against Lumian Lee, he would swiftly produce Sun Holy Water and sprinkle it on him.
target: Ergo, si Corona Purificationis contra Lumian Lee inefficax occideretur, celeriter aquam sanctam solis creare atque in eum aspergeret.

source: Looking at Lumian, Lato Guiaro smiled, once again dyeing the surroundings golden as layer after layer spread out.
target: Spectans ad Lumian, Lato Guiaro subridet, iterum circumiecta aurea colorans, dum stratum post stratum diffundebatur.

source: This sealed environment was ideal for employing the Purification Halo.
target: Hoc clausum ambitum ideale erat ad usum Coronae Purificationis.

source: It denied Lumian Lee a chance to distance himself or “teleport” closer.
target: Illud negabat Lumian Lee occasionem ut distantiam augeret aut propius “teleportaret”.

source: The entire hall was essentially enveloped by the Purification Halo!
target: Omnis aula prorsus Corona Purificationis complectebatur!

source: Furthermore, in the spaceship, there was no fear of Lumian Lee losing control and transforming into a monster, unleashing the high-level creature within his body.
target: Praeterea, in nave, nullus timor erat ne Lumian Lee moderamen amitteret et in monstrum mutaretur, efferens creaturam altam intra corpus eius.

source: An intruder at this level would inevitably trigger the spaceship’s automatic defense system targeting him.
target: Invasor huius gradus inevitabiliter systema defensionis automatae navis, quod in eum destinatum esset, excitaret.

source: Lato Guiaro might then seize control of the spaceship!
target: Lato Guiaro igitur navem possidere posset!

source: Didn’t your sister tell you something Emperor Roselle once said?
target: Nonne soror tua tibi aliquid dixerat, quod Imperator Roselle aliquando dixit?

source: If you rely on something to obtain specialness and become stronger, you will definitely be punished because of it!
target: Si in re aliqua specialitatem adipisci et fortior fieri confidas, certe pro ea punitus eris!

source: Upon seeing the surging layers of golden light, Lumian raised his right hand and vanished.
target: Videns strata lucis aureae emergentes, Lumian dextram manum elevavit et evanuit.

source: Where is he “teleporting” to this time?
target: Quo hunc “teleportat” hoc tempore?

source: As long as he’s in the hall, he can’t avoid the Purification Halo!
target: Dum in aula manet, Corona Purificationis vitari non potest!

source: Lato Guiaro watched the other party’s struggle with certainty and a smile.
target: Lato Guiaro certus et cum subridente aspiciens certamen alterius partis observabat.

source: Unless Lumian Lee chose to leave the hall, it was impossible for him not to be affected by the Purification Halo.
target: Nisi Lumian Lee aulam relinquere decideret, impossibile erat ne Corona Purificationis eum non afficeret.

source: With the spaceship’s barrier raised, the door closed, and the place sealed, and using the unique power of the sea, if he wanted to “teleport” out, he had to first destroy the surrounding walls or metal doors to create an exit.
target: Cum munimentum navis elevatum, porta clausa, et locus sigillatus esset, atque potentia unice maris utendo, si exire “teleportare” vellet, primum circumiectos muros vel portam metallicam ad exitum creandum delere debebat.

source: This was also advantageous for Lato Guiaro.
target: Hoc quoque Lato Guiaro commode fuit.

source: No one knew what the spaceship would unleash in this hall next!
target: Nemo sciebat quid navis in hac aula postea evelleret!

source: Layer after layer of Purification Halos rapidly “drowned” Lumian’s original location, but nothing happened.
target: Stratum post stratum Coronae Purificationis celeriter locum originarium Lumiani submergebat, sed nihil evenit.

source: Lumian’s figure was nowhere to be seen in the silver-white hall.
target: Figura Lumiani nusquam in aula argenteo-alba apparuit.

source: Wh… Lato Guiaro’s pupils constricted.
target: Heu... Pupillae Lato Guiaro contractae sunt.

source: Where did Lumian Lee go?
target: Quo ivit Lumian Lee?

source: Is his teleportation ability unaffected by the sealed interior of the spaceship?
target: Num facultas ejus “teleportandi” ab interiore navis sigillato non afficitur?

source: Or has he gone into hiding?
target: An se occultavit?

source: Lato Guiaro’s heart skipped a beat; he extended his right hand and pulled.
target: Cor Lato Guiaro titubavit; dextram manum extendit et traxit.

source: The void in the hall stirred, unveiling an abnormal area nestled between two walls, flanked by dark holes emitting cerulean-blue gas.
target: Vacuum in aula movit, revelans regionem abnormem inter duas parietes, cum hiatus obscuris gas caeruleo emittentibus.

source: Creating an unstable space and hiding inside to avoid the Purification Halo? That’s true.
target: Creare spatium instabile et intus celare, ut Corona Purificationis vitetur? Id verum est.

source: The Purification Halo’s purpose is to exorcize, purify, warm, and provide courage.
target: Propositum Coronae Purificationis est exorcizare, purgare, calefacere, atque fortitudinem praebere.

source: Without substantial offensive power, it can’t destroy the structure of that space…
target: Sine potestate offensiva substantiali, structuram illius spatii delere non potest…

source: Lumian Lee actually possesses such an ability.
target: Lumian Lee revera talem facultatem possidet.

source: Lato Guiaro quickly saw through Lumian’s trick.
target: Lato Guiaro celeriter insidias Lumiani perspexit.

source: Calmly raising his right hand, he condensed a penetrating dark-green ray.
target: Dextro manu tranquille elevante, radium obscurum viride penetrantem condensavit.

source: Simultaneously, he harnessed his basic control over gravity to pull at the fabricated space.
target: Simul, administrationem fundamentalem gravitatis ad spatium fabricatum trahendum adhibuit.

source: The dark-green ray struck the spot where it had been pulled, instantly penetrating and obliterating the structure.
target: Radium obscurum viride locum, ad quem trahendum erat, percussit, statim penetrans et structuram abrogans.

source: Silently shattered, the dark-green ray continued forward, hitting a silver-white full-body armor with its back turned to Lato Guiaro.
target: Silentio confractum, radium obscurum viride pergens in loricam totam argenteo-albam percussit, cuius tergum ad Lato Guiaro conversum erat.

source: The dark-green ray, now weakened to a certain extent, faded away.
target: Radium obscurum viride, iam ad certum gradum debilitatus, evanuit.

source: The silver-white full-body armor suddenly pivoted, and two pairs of eyes appeared to lock onto Lato Guiaro from within the vacant helmet.
target: Lorica totum corpus argenteo-album subito vertit, et duo paria oculorum ex intima galeae vacuae apparuerunt, ad Lato Guiaro intendentes.

source: In the next moment, it charged toward the April Fool’s key member, forming a broadsword of light in its hand.
target: In subsequenti momento, illa versus membrum clavis Aprilis Stulti impetum iniit, gladium latum lucis in manu formans.

source: As the silver-white full-body armor rushed out, Lumian’s figure emerged in the corner.
target: Dum lorica totum corpus argenteo-album festinanter progrediebatur, figura Lumiani in angulo emersit.

source: He had utilized the terrain there to arrange a simple Bottle of Fiction, using the large hole that emitted poisonous gas as a symbolic window.
target: Illic terram adhibuit ut simplicem “Bottle of Fiction” ordinaret, utens magno foramine, quod gas venenatum emitteret, quasi fenestra symbolica.

source: His goal was twofold: first, to evade the influence of the Purification Halo, and second, to position the Pride Armor with its back facing Lato Guiaro.
target: Finis eius duplex erat: primo, influentiam Coronae Purificationis evadere; secundo, Loricam Superbiae, cuius tergum ad Lato Guiaro versa esset, constituere.

source: Yes, this cursed armor might only target someone standing a certain distance behind it, but it might not.
target: Ita, haec maledicta lorica forsitan solum aliquem intingeret, qui a certa distantia in tergo staret, sed fortasse non.

source: What if that person not only stood more than ten meters behind it but also attempted to attack it by stabbing it in the back?
target: Quid si iste non tantum plus quam decem metra in tergo staret, sed etiam conaretur eam per tergum perfodiendo oppugnare?

source: The answer was clear!
target: Responsum clarum est!

source: Now, Lumian had a capable helper unafraid of the Purification Halo.
target: Nunc, Lumian adiutor validus, Corona Purificationis non timens, habebat
